answer: The cheapest real defence: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because relic only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice saffron is enforced by the ledger itself: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any knoll approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
